sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Umesh Kumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
As per the report sent by the C.J.M., Jaunpur dated 15.04.2024 the information about notice has been given to the opposite party on mobile phone.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present transfer application has been moved with prayer to transfer the proceeding of Case No.53/2022 (Saurabh Tripathi vs. Lalit Shukla and others) filed under Sections 120B, 323, 379, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Sikrara, District Jaunpur, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, IV, Jaunpur to District Prayagraj/Allahabad during the pendency of the present transfer application before this Hon'ble Court.

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that she is wife of opposite party no.2.

She was subjected to harassment by the opposite party no.2 regarding which an F.I.R. u/s 498A, 323, 504,
506, 379, 377, 406 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act was lodged against opposite party no.2 at Prayagraj in which trial is going on.

Further submitted that a case u/s 125 Cr.P.C. was also filed at Prayagraj which is also being proceeded and a case u/s 9 of Hindu Marriage Act filed by the opposite party at Jaunpur which was transferred by this Court to District Prayagraj

. In counter blast to the aforesaid cases present complaint was filed in Jaunpur by the opposite party no.2, the husband with false allegation against the applicant and her family members only for the purpose of making harassment, therefore, request to transfer the case from Jaunpur to District Prayagraj in court having equivalent jurisdiction in view of the convenience of the applicant.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record and in view of the other cases pending in the courts at Prayagraj and the present case at Jaunpur and also the convenience of the applicant (wife)
and opposite party no.2 (her husband), the Case No.53/22, under Sections 120B, 323, 379, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Sikrara, District Jaunpur is transferred from District Jaunpur to District Prayagraj in the court having equivalent jurisdiction.
Accordingly, this transfer application is allowed.

Order Date :- 16.5.2024 Ashok Gupta  Sonam Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188913415/
